data.narrative:
Spiritus is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Charles Cadieu and Matthew Lee that has raised $41M to date. The broader sector peer set includes one public comparable (ticker: LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer universe lacks sufficient density at the same or adjacent stage with comparable valuation tiers to support a reliable median-based analysis.

Consequently, this valuation rests on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to Series B or equivalent advancement. Using the $41M total raised as a valuation proxy, this approach yields an implied valuation of $82M. This single-method triangulation produces a range of $70M (low) to $94M (high), centered on the $82M median.

The material constraint is reliance on a single applicable method. A peer-median cross-check would normally anchor this estimate but cannot be reliably constructed given the absence of at least three same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with tight valuation proximity in the Climate & Energy sector. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to frontier-tech deployment timelines, technical risk in core technology, and actual burn rate relative to the $41M deployed. A higher-conviction range would require either narrower peer identification or disclosure of Spiritus's revenue traction, unit economics, or technical milestones.
